name: Unfixable
source: 19 years have passed since Event 006. The SDU have become heroes who brought Earthlings and Futurerum back together as allies. It has been two years since Eito Aotsuki married Takumi, the leader of the Special Central Government...
translation: 006事件已经过去19年了。SDU已成为将地球人和Futurerum重新团结为盟友的英雄。青月瑛人与特别中央政府首脑拓海结婚已经两年了……
